page.overview:
What is Fuel?

Fuel is the first track from the album, ReLoad. It was popular with most fans.

Fuel's subject matter is about driving cars, racing, motor vehicles, and living life way too fast. The subject matter is similar to that of "Motorbreath" from Kill 'Em All.

Gimme fuel, gimme fire Gimme that which I desire

Turn on, I see red Adrenaline crash and crack my head Nitro junkie, paint me dead And I see red
